alternatives_rejected.why: Caller-observed p50 latency rose only 1.11x (3.85->4.29ms) while caller errors jumped 0->0.51 (E2). That pattern is dropped packets causing failures, not uniform added latency.

The socket deviation (z=86.98, E3) is far smaller than the latency deviation (z>700). It fits connection churn and retransmits caused by loss better than a primary socket fault. Own spans show no errors, only callers do (E2).
productcatalogservice does not appear among the top deviations across all services (E1). recommendationservice's caller-side errors point at the link into recommendationservice itself (E2).

proposed_fix.description: Inspect recommendationservice's pod network interface for packet loss (for example a tc/netem rule or a faulty node NIC) and remove the cause. If the cause is node-level, cordon the node and reschedule the pod onto healthy hardware. Then confirm caller error rate returns to 0 and the latency percentiles return to baseline.
